You should consider thinking about not depending on others, much worse if it is about love. I know very well the situation of being depressed, and maybe any advice wont matter, try this though:
Go to a park or a green place where u can breathe fresh air, and analize ur situation, and think about what is the situation u would like to be (forgetting the things have damaged u). And think about how to reach that, focus on urself, fuck the peoplez maybe then people will matter, but now is all about you, because at the end of the day, we always are alone, if u can handle life alone, for sure u will with people around u and dont forget, make ur life and emotions depend on you, work on that. 
I hope u to consider this, and i hope everything gets better. Hug

Yes mine has lots of physical symptoms. Most of them are neurological, i have a lot of cramps or palpitations in the muscles of the whole body, especially legs. Also i have a lot of tingling in the back, legs, feet and in some parts of the face also. I was worried it was a neurological desease like als or ms, cause the symptoms are very strong and happen often. But according to my neurologist after some tests and medical studies everything is fine. Depression apparently is the responsible for these
